feature: member message visibility query and indexes

note: Member pages now read a UNION of three indexed visibility branches and take the minimum of three LIMIT 1 seeks for earliest_available_id. The previous OR predicate scanned the whole conversation tail for members with few visible messages. UNION also removes duplicate rows matched by two branches (self-authored broadcast, self-directed message).
